name: Meret
description: Meret is a Stars-faction Note-based support who distributes Sun, Moon, and Star Notes to key allies at battle start. Notes provide shields, attack buffs, and energy — and with Harmony of All Things, Note-bearers share damage with each other, creating a distributed damage pool. Her Artifact makes Note-bearers unkillable once, and her heals prioritize the weakest ally. Exceptional at keeping high-value units alive and amplifying their output simultaneously.

skills.name: All Heavens in Praise
skills.description: Passive: Upon entering battle, Meret distributes three Notes - Sun Note to the ally with the highest Max HP, Moon Note to the ally with the highest ATK, and Star Note to herself. Active: Activates all Notes. Sun grants a shield equal to 30% of Max HP. Moon grants +30% ATK for 8 seconds. Star restores 200 Energy.

upgrades.level2: Sun Note shield is increased to 50% of Max HP.
upgrades.level3: Moon Note also grants +30% ATK and +30% CRIT Rate for 8 seconds.

skills.name: Universal Resonance
skills.description: Marked allies share damage taken. The main target takes 60% of incoming damage, and the remaining 40% is split among other Note holders. Additional effects: Sun grants +10% Max HP, Moon grants +20% damage dealt, Star grants +10% Energy regeneration.

upgrades.level2: Sun Note increases Max HP by 15%.
upgrades.level3: Moon Note increases damage dealt by 30%.
upgrades.level4: Star Note increases Energy regeneration by 15%.

skills.name: Sands in Stride
skills.description: Heals the most vulnerable ally, restoring HP equal to 60% of ATK per second for 5 seconds.

upgrades.level2: Restores HP equal to 70% of ATK per second.
upgrades.level3: If the target has a Note, it also heals for an additional 3% of their Max HP each second.

skills.name: The Curtain Never Falls
skills.description: Passively, when an ally drops below 50% HP, Meret heals them for 25% of their Max HP. Can trigger once per unit.

upgrades.level2: Passively, when any allied unit's HP falls below 50%, Meret heals them for 30% of their Max HP. Can trigger once per unit.
upgrades.level3: Passively, when any allied unit's HP falls below 50%, Meret heals them for 35% of their Max HP. Can trigger once per unit.
upgrades.level4: Each unit has an independend Cooldown of 20 seconds.

relic.name: Endless Echo
relic.description: When a Note-bearing ally would die, prevents their death and grants them a shield equal to 300% of ATK. 15-second cooldown.

upgrades.level2: For each Note on the field, gains 15% DMG Reduction.
upgrades.level3: When a Note unit is about to die, they become immunie to death and gain a shield equal to 400% of ATK. 15s Cooldown.
upgrades.level4: For each Note on the battlefield, gains 27% DMG Reduction.

coreMechanic.summary: Diamond Support with protective life-sharing mechanics. Shields Heracles during ramp-up phase but can slow his energy recovery -- known tradeoff. Insufficient against high enemy burst. r1-10 enough for baseline utility; r30 for full protective output.

relicBreakpoints.effect: Baseline protection unlocked. Usable in Diamond team without further investment pressure.
Full protective capability. Only relevant once Hercules and Bastet are already at Divine.

f2pInvestment.notes: Baseline utility at r1-10. Full potential only realized at r30, and only if paired with high-investment Hercules and Bastet. Not a priority for F2P players until those conditions are met.
